content.user_title: Build a Profitable Notion Template Business
content.value_statement: Notion creators often lack a clear plan for pricing, distribution, marketing, and customer support. This skill turns a template idea into a structured digital product business.
actual_capabilities: Structures Notion template packages with dashboards, documentation, examples, and optional bonuses.
Recommends pricing tiers, value anchors, bundles, and update models.
Compares Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Notion Marketplace, and direct website sales.
Builds launch plans across email, social media, search content, and partner channels.
Designs customer support systems using onboarding, documentation, videos, and frequently asked questions.
Reviews plans for missing previews, documentation, pricing, email capture, and refund policies.
limitations: Does not build or publish pages inside Notion or marketplace platforms.
Pricing ranges are general guidance and require current market research.
Does not provide legal, tax, payment processing, or jurisdiction-specific advice.
Revenue outcomes depend on product quality, audience demand, execution, and platform changes.

use_cases.title: Validate a First Template
use_cases.description: Turn a specific customer problem into a documented template package with an initial price and sales channel.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Store
use_cases.description: Audit pricing, previews, bundles, documentation, email capture, and support processes to identify practical improvements.

use_cases.title: Diversify Template Revenue
use_cases.description: Plan direct sales, marketplace distribution, content marketing, affiliates, and an owned email audience.

prompt_templates.title: Shape My Template Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: I want to create a Notion template for [audience] that solves [problem]. Define the core pages, example data, documentation, and minimum launch package.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting with a basic product idea.

prompt_templates.title: Set Pricing and Tiers
prompt_templates.prompt: Create pricing tiers for my [template type]. Consider time saved, competing products, included support, bonuses, updates, and a possible bundle.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the product scope is clear but pricing is undecided.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Template Launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a four-week launch plan for my [template] using my [audience size], [channels], [budget], and [launch date]. Include preparation, launch, and follow-up.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when preparing coordinated marketing and sales activities.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Scale My Business
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Notion template business using these details: [products], [prices], [channels], [sales], [support load], and [email list]. Prioritize five improvements with expected impact.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when optimizing an established template portfolio.

output_examples.input: Plan a basic project management template for freelance designers.
output_examples.output: Package: client dashboard, project database, task board, meeting notes, sample project, setup guide, and FAQ. Test a basic tier at $29.

output_examples.input: My $39 template creates too many support emails.
output: Add a welcome page with a short setup sequence.
Include realistic example data and explain each database view.
Create a searchable FAQ from recent support questions.
Reserve direct email support for a higher-priced tier.

output_examples.input: Reduce my dependence on one marketplace.
output_examples.output: Create a direct storefront, capture email through a useful free template, publish search-focused tutorials, and test a second marketplace before shifting traffic.

best_practices: Start with one specific audience problem and validate demand before expanding the template.
Show the complete product through clear previews, example data, documentation, and a demonstration video.
Track sales, refunds, support questions, and channel performance before changing prices or adding products.
anti_patterns: Do not price only from build time while ignoring customer value and competing products.
Do not launch without setup instructions, preview images, sample data, and a clear refund policy.
Do not depend entirely on one marketplace or platform-controlled audience.

faq.question: Can this skill build the Notion template for me?
faq.answer: It can design the structure and content plan, but it does not create or publish pages inside Notion.

faq.question: Does it recommend a fixed price?
faq.answer: It proposes ranges and tiers based on value, scope, support, and comparable products. Validate every price with current market evidence.

faq.question: Which sales platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It compares Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Notion Marketplace, and direct website sales.

faq.question: Can it create a marketing plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize pre-launch, launch, and ongoing activities across email, social media, search content, directories, and affiliates.

faq.question: How does it help reduce support work?
faq.answer: It recommends better onboarding, example data, documentation, videos, frequently asked questions, support tiers, and reusable responses.

faq.question: Does it guarantee template revenue?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on demand, product quality, audience access, pricing, execution, and platform conditions.
